coordinate_semantics.finding: Darwin Core child Point rows repeat the transect-start coordinate (meter mark 0) rather than literal meter-mark coordinates.
coordinate_semantics.reconstruction: Use pinned transect-start longitude/latitude + signed line-derived bearing stored in locationRemarks + signed meter-mark distance from child locationID.
coordinate_semantics.bearing_interpretation: The '(+/- 180 from N)' text describes the signed bearing convention; it is not a 180-degree directional ambiguity.
coordinate_semantics.conversion_provenance: obis-example derives bearing from the original tbeptools trnlns LINESTRING and stores it in the pinned Darwin Core locationRemarks.

superseded_startpoint_only_result.interpretation: Do not use these counts for field feasibility. They measured meadow-edge distance at meter mark 0 only and ignored the spatial extent of each fixed transect.

corrected_meter_mark_registry_precheck.note: Signed and >1-km Site values are retained as source-defined offsets; no clipping is applied.

decision: No scientific GIS feasibility pass/fail is assigned until the corrected meter-mark spatial workflow completes. Frozen thresholds are unchanged.
claim_boundary: The superseded start-point-only candidate count is provenance, not evidence.
No future biological response is used in the corrected spatial audit.
A GIS edge candidate still requires field validation of depth match, comparable forcing, substrate/context, wake contamination and simultaneous sensor geometry.
Do not relax the frozen 100-m / 12-node / 3-per-bay rules after the corrected result is opened.
